The full suite is green now: 517 of 517 tests pass. Two commits since v2.0.0 caused the 8 failures, and I fixed both in `src/`. I didn't touch the tests and I haven't committed anything.

- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** `buildInvoice` in `src/invoice.js` started taxing the full subtotal (`const taxable = subtotal`), so order codes like SPRING10 no longer reduced the tax. I changed it to `subtotal - discount`. The new `lineDiscounts` and `taxable` fields, the line-discount validation and the empty-invoice check are all still there.
- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`):** the cents part used `padEnd` instead of `padStart` in `src/money.js`, so 1 cent printed as `$0.10` instead of `$0.01`. I switched it back to `padStart`. The comma grouping stays.

The two `renderInvoice` failures went away with the tax fix and the `formatMoney` fix.
